---
title: "hsm"
description: "optionally sources the CA key from a PKCS#11 token instead of ssh_key"
---

<!-- Generated by genconfdocs from the config structs in server/config. Do not edit. -->

Exactly one of the two may be set at the config level (API mode has neither; signing modes require one to be set). See https://mnestor.github.io/ssoossh/operations/hsm/ for setup.  Supported: ECDSA P-256/384/521, RSA >= 2048. Ed25519 is not supported by PKCS#11 here; keep ssh_key for an Ed25519 CA.

| Key | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`hsm.module`](#module) | string | `empty` |
| [`hsm.token_label`](#token_label) | string | `empty` |
| [`hsm.pin`](#pin) | string | `empty` |
| [`hsm.pin_file`](#pin_file) | string | `empty` |
| [`hsm.key_label`](#key_label) | string | `empty` |
| [`hsm.key_id`](#key_id) | string | `empty` |

## `module`

`string`, default `empty`

The absolute path to the PKCS#11 shared library, e.g. /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so. Setting it enables HSM mode.

```yaml
hsm:
  module: "/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so"
```

## `token_label`

`string`, default `empty`

Selects the token (softhsm2-util --init-token --label ...).

```yaml
hsm:
  token_label: "ssoossh-ca"
```

## `pin`

`string`, default `empty`

The user PIN. Mutually exclusive with PINFile.

```yaml
hsm:
  pin: "1234"
```

## `pin_file`

`string`, default `empty`

A path whose trimmed contents are the user PIN. Preferred over inline PIN so the config file can stay world-readable-ish.

```yaml
hsm:
  pin_file: "/etc/ssoossh/hsm-pin"
```

## `key_label`

`string`, default `empty`

Selects the key pair by CKA_LABEL. At least one of `key_label` or `key_id` is required; when both are set both must match.

```yaml
hsm:
  key_label: "ssoossh-ca"
```

## `key_id`

`string`, default `empty`

Selects the key pair by CKA_ID, hex-encoded (pkcs11-tool --id).

```yaml
hsm:
  key_id: "01"
```
